messages:
sam_support: Customer reported a sudden p50/p95 jump on /v1/generate in us-east-1 after the 2026-02-12 runtime deploy. They see p50 ~220ms -> ~520ms and p95 spikes to 1.8s. No 5xx but many 504-ish downstream timeouts. Request IDs: 01FZ9A3X0K, 01FZ9A3X1L, 01FZ9B7Y2M (sample).

mike_eng: thanks — can you attach a short repro pack: sample curl (with auth redacted), concurrency pattern, token counts, and any client-side timings? Prefer a 5–10 minute trace that reproduces the high p50.

sam_support: collecting now. Customer is running mix of short prompts (~40–80 tokens) and long completions (~600 tokens) with bursty traffic: 8 clients, occasional spikes to 120 concurrent requests. I asked for logs; they pasted these lines: 
```
2026-02-12T16:04:08Z INFO request=01FZ9A3X0K model=redwood-2L seq=512 tokens=48 latency_ms=523 backend=runtime-3 shard=shard-7 cache=miss
2026-02-12T16:04:09Z INFO request=01FZ9A3X1L model=redwood-2L seq=1024 tokens=612 latency_ms=1870 backend=runtime-2 shard=shard-3 cache=hit
2026-02-12T16:04:09Z WARN request=01FZ9B7Y2M model=redwood-2L latency_ms=1205 backend=runtime-1 err=slow-queue
```

jessica_sre: deploy-bot shows a canary roll at ~2026-02-12T15:58:00Z to runtime-2 that had kernel tweaks. That could explain throughput gap. @mike_eng can you run a short stress-replay using this script and the customer's promptset? Run for 10m with these params: concurrency=120, p95 tokens ~600, mean tokens ~200.

mike_eng: copying a quick stress command (use customer token or a test key):
```
# stress replay (example)
cat prompts.txt | xargs -n1 -P120 -I{} curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2L","input":"{}","max_tokens":600}'
```

mike_eng: also please enable debug header to capture service request IDs in responses so we can correlate across proxies: `x-debug: trace,include-reqid`. We need full proxy logs + runtime logs for timeline.

sam_support: uploaded customer curl traces + a zipped promptset to S3: s3://redwood-debug/esc-1789001234/customer-A/trace-20260212.tar.gz (link posted to the ticket). Included concurrency profile (CSV) and client-side timings.

alice_cust: confirming I added the tenant-id and tracing header. Re-run with the stress snippet above and you'll see the p50 jump after ~3 minutes.

jessica_sre: one more ask — collect a `strace -f -p <pid>` and `nvidia-smi dmon` for 2 minutes during the repro (runtime on dedicated test infra). Kernel tweaks affected kernel scheduling in that deploy. If we see sustained GPU stalls it's likely a kernel/kernel-driver regression.

mike_eng: noted. For immediate triage: can we compare perf counters between runtime-1 and runtime-2 (shard-3 vs shard-7)? If cache miss rate increased on shard-7 that's suspicious. Example quick grep: `grep "cache=miss" runtime.log | wc -l` over the window. Also capture KV cache hit ratio from /internal/metrics.

sam_support: customer sent a short heap of logs and I included them in the bundle. Also pasted client curl that reproduces a 504: 
```
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "x-debug: trace,include-reqid" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2L","input":"short prompt","max_tokens":128}'
```

mike_eng: great. I'll run the replay on parity infra tonight and attach the timeline. If we reproduce, we'll rollback the kernel tweak from 15:58 canary and see effect.

jessica_sre: filing an ops ticket to snapshot affected hosts + toke audit: OPS-2026-498. tagging runtime on-call. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout to runtime-2 at 2026-02-12T15:58:00Z by @deploy-engineer completed (id: canary-20260212-15).

sam_support: thanks team — keeping the customer updated. I'll paste the S3 link and the customer confirms the 10m stress reproduces the spike. Next steps: mike to run controlled replay, jessica to collect kernel/GPU traces, then a rollback if reproduced.

mike_eng: will update here with results + timeline (ETA 6h).
